tools.description: List video effect templates (dance, sports, meme scenes, etc.). Use the returned `effect` id with animate_photo. `photos` is how many photos the effect needs.
tools.name: list_effects
tools.title: List video effects

tools.description: Turn photo(s) into a short video. With `effect` (from list_effects) the effect decides the motion; without it the photo is animated following `prompt`. Costs credits. Returns a task_id; poll get_video for the result (usually 1–5 minutes).

effect.description: Effect id from list_effects. Omit for a free-form animation.

image_urls.description: Public https image URLs (or data:image/...;base64 URLs), in the order the effect asks for. Usually one photo.

prompt.description: Motion description for free-form animation, or extra instructions for an effect.

tools.name: animate_photo
tools.title: Animate a photo

tools.description: Generate a short video (5 seconds, 720p, with sound) from a text description only, no photo needed. Costs credits. Returns a task_id; poll get_video.

aspect_ratio.description: 9:16 for TikTok / Reels / Shorts (default), 16:9 for landscape, 1:1 square.

prompt.description: What happens in the video: subject, action, setting, camera, mood.

tools.name: create_video
tools.title: Create a video from text

tools.description: Edit an existing video clip (MP4, up to 15 seconds, 50 MB) following instructions: put the person from a photo into the clip, change outfit, style, background or scene, while keeping the motion and timing. Costs credits (based on clip length). Returns a task_id; poll get_video.

image_urls.description: Optional reference photos, referred to as image 1, image 2… in the prompt.

prompt.description: What to change, e.g. "Replace the dancer with the person in image 1, keep the moves".

video_url.description: Public https URL of the MP4 clip to edit.

tools.name: edit_video
tools.title: Edit a video

tools.description: Generate a new image from text, or edit photo(s) following instructions (change background, outfit, style, lighting, combine several photos). Uses Nano Banana 2 at 1K. Costs credits. Usually returns the image directly; if status is pending, call get_image later.

aspect_ratio.description: auto (default) keeps the input photo's shape.

image_urls.description: Photos to edit or combine. Omit to generate from text only.

prompt.description: The image to create, or the edit to make to the photo(s).

tools.name: create_image
tools.title: Create or edit an image

tools.description: Repair an old or damaged photo: remove scratches, dust, creases and fading, recover sharp faces, keep everyone exactly as they are. Optionally colorize a black-and-white photo. Costs credits. Returns the restored image (or pending → get_image). Tip: animate the result with animate_photo afterwards.

colorize.description: Also colorize a black-and-white or sepia photo. Default false.

image_url.description: Public https URL of the old photo (a scan or phone photo of a print is fine).

tools.name: restore_photo
tools.title: Restore an old photo

tools.description: Check an image task from create_image or restore_photo. status is pending, success (image_url ready) or failed (credits refunded).

task_id.description: task_id returned by create_image or restore_photo

tools.name: get_image
tools.title: Get image status

tools.description: Check a generation task. status is pending, success (video_url ready) or failed (credits refunded).

task_id.description: task_id returned by animate_photo, create_video or edit_video

tools.name: get_video
tools.title: Get video status

tools.description: The user's most recent video generations, newest first.
tools.name: list_my_videos
tools.title: List my videos

tools.description: Remaining credits and plan of the connected account.
tools.name: get_credits
tools.title: Get credits
